results.title: Rainbrand | B2B | Standout | Standout
results.content:
Rainbrand (rainbrand.com, formerly Bloom / trybloom.ai, YC) is the brand layer for agents — an MCP-first product that turns a company's brand into infrastructure. Rainbrand turns a brand's identity, guidance and assets into shared context that agents and products can use, callable from anywhere in the stack — frontend, product design, branding, ads — via MCP and API (CLI coming), so any agent, app, or person produces on-brand output: images, copy, landing pages, campaigns. Originally launched Dec 2025 as Bloom, an on-brand AI image generator (viral launch, 1.4M views, 14K users first week), it pivoted in 2026 to an agent-first "brand-as-infrastructure" model, relaunched on YC in June 2026, and rebranded from Bloom to Rainbrand in Oct 2026. 500K+ assets generated with Rainbrand.
